results.name: ASSA ABLOY to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control – BeBeez International
results.content:
STOCKHOLM, Aug. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — ASSA ABLOY has signed an agreement to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control, an international provider of entrance control solutions, including speed gates, mass transit gates and security revolving doors.  
“I look forward to welcoming the Gunnebo Entrance Control team to ASSA ABLOY. This acquisition delivers on our strategy to strengthen our position in mature markets through adding complementary products and solutions to our core business,” says Nico Delvaux, President and CEO of ASSA ABLOY.  
“Gunnebo Entrance Control’s well-established entrance control portfolio, strong team, and deep industry expertise will enhance and complement our current offering in pedestrian access solutions,” says Massimo Grassi, Executive Vice President of ASSA ABLOY and Head of Entrance Systems Division. “By adding talented people, strong expertise, and innovative solutions, we will further strengthen our ability to support customers with secure, reliable and efficient entrance solutions.”  
Formed in 1995, with a history dating back to 1764, the company has around 670 employees. The company is headquartered in Maresfield, UK, with manufacturing sites across Europe, the US and Asia. Gunnebo Entrance Control will be part of the Business Segment Pedestrian within the Entrance Systems Division.  
Sales for 2025 amounted to about MEUR 151 (approx. MSEK 1,670) with a good EBIT margin. The acquisition will initially have a small dilutive effect on EPS.
The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions and is expected to close during the fourth quarter of 2026.  
**For more information, please contact:**Nico Delvaux, President and CEO, tel. no: +46 8 506 485 82
Erik Pieder, CFO and Executive Vice President, tel. no: +46 8 506 485 72
Björn Tibell, Head of Investor Relations, tel. no: +46 70 275 67 68, E-mail: [bjorn.tibell@assaabloy.com](https://bebeez.eu/2026/08/03/assa-abloy-to-acquire-gunnebo-entrance-control/mailto:bjorn.tibell@assaabloy.com)  
**About ASSA ABLOY**  
ASSA ABLOY is the global leader in access solutions. Every day we help people feel safe, secure and experience a more open world. We operate worldwide with 64,000 employees and sales of SEK 152 billion, with leading positions in areas such as efficient door openings, trusted identities and entrance automation. Our innovations enable safe, secure and convenient access to physical and digital places.

results.name: Shuretech Acquired by Gunnebo Entrance Control - Entrepreneurs Hub
results.content:
# Shuretech Acquired by Gunnebo Entrance Control  
## Entrepreneurs Hub advise Shuretech on sale to international security business Gunnebo Entrance Control  
Shuretech, a provider of integrated whole-site security access solutions, has been acquired by Gunnebo Entrance Control, a global provider of entrance control solutions.  
The acquisition was facilitated by corporate finance boutique Entrepreneurs Hub Ltd – a firm that provides strategic growth and expert business sales advice to SME business owners and entrepreneurs across the UK.  
Established in 2011, Shuretech has grown to offer a comprehensive site security service to businesses and high-net-worth individuals. The company has a particularly strong offering within the highly sensitive data centre sector.  
Having joined the business in 2018 and 2020 respectively, Lewis Hakesley and Carl Graham acquired shares through an MBO in 2021. Having achieved their aims for the business, Lewis and Carl came to Entrepreneurs Hub to help them secure the future growth of the business by finding a suitable acquisition partner.  
**Lewis and Carl said:**  
*I would wholeheartedly recommend Entrepreneurs Hub without hesitation.*  
*The process was demanding and time-consuming and we cannot imagine navigating it without experienced advisors. The value added by the Entrepreneurs Hub team was exceptional. Their combined experience on both the buying and selling sides, particularly in financial matters, proved invaluable.*
*We had ambitious expectations and a clear target we both wanted to walk away with. The team not only met but exceeded our objectives. Without their guidance, we now believe we would have been significantly disadvantaged during negotiations and would not have achieved the outcome we ultimately secured.*  
Gunnebo was identified as a strong suiter in the process due to its service-led model, company ethos and global reach.  
**Howard Lang, President of Gunnebo Entrance Control, concluded:**  
*Bringing Shuretech into the business significantly strengthens our UK engineering capability and reinforces our service-led model. It positions us to deliver greater consistency, accountability and long-term support for customers who depend on secure, high-performing entrance control systems.*  
**James Guglia, who led the deal for Entrepreneurs Hub said:**  
*This transaction was about positioning a high-quality physical security platform in the right strategic context. By reframing the equity story around its exposure to critical infrastructure and data centre end-markets, we were able to generate genuine competitive tension and secure a strong outcome for Carl and Lewis.*  
*The cross border interest from Gunnebo Entrance Control reflected the company ethos and quality of the business alongside the clarity of the growth narrative we built.*
